title: Publish recovery log
description: The structural shape of one entry in a recovery log recorded while recovering a partially failed npm publish. This schema is deliberately shallow -- it cannot express the FIXED ORDER across entries (resume/rollback must settle before npmVersionCheck, which must reconcile before issueClose, and nothing may follow a closed log). That stateful, retry-aware sequencing is the job of validateRecoveryOrder in publishRecoveryContract.ts; this schema only rejects a malformed entry before it ever reaches that validator.

phase.description: One of the four recovery phases this contract fixes the order of.

outcome.description: "failed" permits retrying the same phase; it never permits skipping ahead to the next one.
